Xbox Hub private-source build validation trigger
Request: verify valid workflow, Windows x64 package build, signer, encrypted package round trip, versioned ZIP handoff path, and updater transactions
Source version: 0.1.7-preview.1
Source commit: 6b0c2e0954bf238d7373ce57aafcc9cf7238d19b
Scope: Windows x64 restore, app/updater publish, exact two-file ZIP validation, create versioned runner-local ZIP, offline manifest signer positive/negative tests, AES-256-GCM/RSA-OAEP encrypted package round trip with a password-protected ephemeral RSA key, tamper rejection, and updater transaction tests.
Security: ephemeral keys/passphrase only; no owner keys or production secrets are used. No plaintext package, private source, TLS key, Cloudflare token, or credential is uploaded. Optional ciphertext artifact remains skipped until the owner's package-encryption public key is configured.
